messages:
erin: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to rename 'burst credits' -> 'burst allowance' across rate-limits/quota pages. Need quick SDK snippet updates, a short billing blurb, and dashboard panel title changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :eyes:

nora: on it. I'll update py/ts snippets and the migration guide. Any backend or metric changes required?

alex: backend metric names stay the same, we're doing a cosmetic rename in docs + console only. Console label change will ship in the next console deploy but mapping remains identical.

liam: note: Grafana panel currently reads 'Burst usage' and references metric `redwood.burst_credits_used`. We should keep the metric name but update panel title and panel description to mention the rename. I'll prepare the dashboard JSON patch.

nora: drafting python snippet now — proposing we show the new header name in examples for migration clarity:

```python
import requests
resp = requests.get(
    'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage',
    headers={
        'Authorization': 'Bearer <token>',
        'X-Redwood-Allowance': 'true'  # new docs-friendly header name
    }
)
print(resp.json())
```

nora: and TypeScript snippet too:

```ts
await fetch('/v1/usage', {
  method: 'GET',
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` ,
    'X-Redwood-Allowance': 'true' // migration example header
  }
})
```

erin: perfect — add an explicit note: metric names/alerts unchanged so customers' Grafana/alerting rules won't break. Also add an HTML redirect from /docs/burst-credits -> /docs/burst-allowance to avoid 404s.

alex: console PR will update the UI label only. Planned console deploy: 2026-04-02 UTC. I'll include a short entry in the console changelog about the rename.

liam: dashboard patch submitted: https://grafana.internal/redwood/p/1234/usage-panels — I changed titles/descriptions and left metric names as-is. I'll add a migration note in the panel docs.

docs-ci-bot: docs build passed for PR #4321 — all checks green :white_check_mark:

erin: thanks — one more: can you add a small billing paragraph along the lines of 'name change only; no changes to billing calculations or quotas'? We should be explicit.

nora: added a 2-line billing blurb to the migration guide and pushed a commit. Also updated SDK changelog snippet under 'migration' section. CC @alex to avoid UI/console drift. :thumbsup:

alex: will wait for docs merge then merge console PR after staging smoke tests pass.

liam: adding a one-line migration note to the release notes for this deploy.

erin: last ask: update the SDK landing page examples to show the new header and add a tiny note in the Python/TS examples about backward compatibility.

nora: done and pushed. full files diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321/files

erin: great work, thanks everyone — closing the loop. Will post deploy reminder in #eng-releases when console deploy is scheduled. :tada:
